steps.reason: #1948: the monolithic "Test front" step was renamed to "Test front (non-vitest)" and now runs only the non-vitest checks (pnpm --filter front test:ci-non-vitest). The vitest suite moved out into its own 4-way shard matrix job (test-vitest, run via --shard=i/4) plus a parallel coverage-equality job (test-vitest-coverage), so no verification work was dropped — the split is what makes shard failures report independently instead of masking later steps (#1699). The replacement steps are reconciled as new manifest entries in the same commit.

steps.step_id: require-linked-issue.yml::require-linked-issue::Verify the PR closes an existing issue
steps.reason: #2003: renamed to "Verify the PR links an existing issue" because the guard now accepts explicit non-closing relationships for honest partial slices as well as closing keywords. The replacement step keeps real-issue validation and pull-request rejection; no verification was removed.

#2049 pruning: the PR-body prose parser is removed after a verified false positive on quoted and retracted claims. This checkout existed only to run that non-critical parser; the separate require-linked-issue job remains intact.

steps.step_id: require-linked-issue.yml::pr-body-exhaustiveness::Verify the PR body makes no unverifiable exhaustiveness claims (#1569)
steps.reason: #2049 pruning: this lexical PR-prose check cannot distinguish an assertion from a quotation, retraction, result, or hypothesis. Removing it avoids growing a Markdown and natural-language analyzer; no runtime, security, data, API, supply-chain, or CI-integrity invariant is lost.
